nsca_password.description: The password/passphrase used to encrypt outgoing packets. Must match the nsca daemon configuration.

nsca_encryption_method.description: The encryption method used by the send_nsca client. Must match the nsca daemon configuration. Common values: 0=None, 1=XOR, 2=DES, 3=3DES.

nsca_legacy_2_7_mode.description: Enable backward compatibility mode for version 2.7, limiting packets to 512 bytes.
